public_health_question.v: Should all U.S. adults known or suspected to be unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated against polio complete a primary IPV series, and which adults may receive a booster?

ev.q: ACIP voted to recommend that all U.S. adults aged ≥18 years who are known or suspected to be unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated against polio

equity.level_reason: Age (adults aged ≥18 years) only defines the population; equity is named only as a generic Evidence to Recommendations framework consideration, with no SPD results.

ev.q: Adults aged ≥18 years who are known or suspected to be unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated against polio should complete a primary vaccination series with IPV.

notes: ACIP recommendation report; all quantities (Rockland County coverage, national 93.4% coverage, seroconversion and adverse-event percentages) are cited from earlier reports, so data_focus is limited with empty method fields. vaccine_outcome_type left null because the report computes no vaccine epidemiology of its own.
